summary: The team is prioritizing China-based programs Asia Star and Intelligent China for SEO and marketing while managing urgent operational issues like Outlook password updates and knowledge website design feedback.
summaryDetail: The most immediate priority is resolving the Outlook account lockout—all team members must delete and re-login on all devices and contact JSB to confirm the backend unlock. In parallel, the knowledge website redesign is in full swing: Joseph must share the HTML file, the team will meet to finalize feedback, and Joker will implement changes, with decisions to remove the videos panel, center the menu, and integrate BCI/BSI indices. The global marketing strategy is pivoting to prioritize Asia Star and Intelligent China, requiring Joseph to draft a plan, the team to analyze participant profiles, and an audit of conversion tracking, while US programs are deprioritized. Upcoming deadlines include the EQUIS re-accreditation press release review (Oct 9), font copyright investigation (Oct 10), and photographer booking for Asia Start's Beijing campus visit (Nov 2). Additionally, follow-ups are needed for the Sino-Swiss Economic Forum and Asia Start participant interviews, and the CCG event on October 17 has been cancelled.
